svg.title: At any center (λ, A) with Ω−1/32λ ∈[17/20, 23/20] and ∥A∥P ≤1/8, every neighboring center within distance 1/8, followed by any direction of norm at most 1/4, stays in the enlarged scalar window and activity ball used in (LCN3). Recover the line series at radius q/4. Polarization makes its degree-n coefficient a symmetric multilinear map: the finite difference formula divides by n!, has 2n summands, and each sum of n unit vectors has norm at most n. Since nn/n! ≤en, the resulting multilinear coefficient is bounded by  2e (1/4)(q/4) n C, C = 2d or 2fi. (LCN5)
